subject: Cloud Computing
title: The Well-Architected Framework
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Well-Architected Framework.

hook.text: AWS published a checklist for building cloud systems right. It became the industry's architecture bible.

buildup.text: The framework covers six pillars: security, reliability, performance, cost optimization, operations, and sustainability.

discovery.text: Azure and Google published their own versions. The pillars are similar because good architecture is universal.

twist.text: No system excels at all six pillars simultaneously. Every architecture makes trade-offs between them.

climax.text: The framework isn't a recipe — it's a conversation starter. It forces teams to think about trade-offs explicitly.

punchline.text: Good architecture is about trade-offs. The framework makes them visible.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of the Well-Architected Framework?
options: To guide teams in making explicit architecture trade-offs across key pillars
To provide a single correct way to build all cloud systems
To certify that a cloud system will never experience failures

details.summary: The Well-Architected Framework is a set of best practices from cloud providers for building secure, reliable, efficient, cost-optimized, and sustainable workloads. AWS, Azure, and GCP each publish their own version with review tools and guidance documents.
details.whyItMatters: The framework provides a structured way to evaluate cloud architectures against industry best practices. It prevents common pitfalls and gives teams a shared vocabulary for architecture reviews.
takeaways: Covers security, reliability, performance, cost, and sustainability
Each major cloud provider publishes their own version
Review tools help identify gaps in existing architectures

faq.question: What are the pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework?
faq.answer: The six pillars are operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability. Each pillar includes design principles, best practices, and questions to evaluate workloads against those standards.

faq.question: How do you conduct a Well-Architected review?
faq.answer: Walk through the framework questions for each pillar with your team. Identify high-risk issues and create an improvement plan. AWS offers a free Well-Architected Tool in the console that guides the review and tracks remediation items.
